title: Prana SOBE 115 NDE 115
content:
I was delirious with fever following a miscarriage. May have become unconscious. But when this happened, I was awake and was aware of what was happening around. I remember that my child was sleeping inside and my husband was in the kitchen. When this was happening he was near me and I could hear him say that I think she is very ill. Suddenly I could no longer move or even lift a finger. As I was struggling to move, there was a sudden jerk and I was pushed out of my body and was floating upwards. I could see my husband near my body. I was hoping he would touch me or shake me so that I may be able to get back. But he merely looked at me. I wanted to tell him that I was not unconscious but dead. After reaching a level I stopped and stood still for some time. I wanted to call my husband and tell him about this. But could not do anything. But then, I slowly came down in the same way and with a jerk entered the body. Suddenly I was able to move and jumped up. The only after effect is that I have developed claustrophobia.

Uncertain Childbirth High fever followed by miscarriage Did you feel separated from your body? Yes There was a sudden jerk following my inability to move. I was forced out of my body and drifted upwards slowly but steadily. I got back in the same way. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? Delirious with fever. May have become unconscious. But when this happened I was awake and was aware of what was happening around. Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see an unearthly light? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? Mixed emotions Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I feel I know what to expect after death. It makes me feel better about it. Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No Has not affected these areas of my life After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes Experience of being weightless and floating and slowly drifting upwards following a feeling of inability to move, even after struggling to move Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? The best part was the feeling that I was floating weightless and moving upward and the feeling that I was going to an unknown world. The worst part was the feeling that I had lost control over my body, could not move, and that I might not see my dear ones again." Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Never believed me and made fun of me, of course. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? No
